thinking_text:
**Formulating functional phrases**

I’m thinking about how “height” applies to both functional classes and behaviors. I need to come up with an exact sentence. I want to emphasize action words, focusing on “Add” as the meaningful phrase, and I’ll reference “click buttons” as part of that. The parameters seem to be "two" and “height of 2 millimeters.” So, I’ll work on creating a functional phrase around this!

request.raw_text: Add two click buttons with the height of 2 millimetre to provide a comfortable and responsive feel for the user
functional_intention_words: provide a comfortable feel for the user
provide a responsive feel for the user

aim.primary_aim: Provide two 2-millimetre-high click buttons that deliver a comfortable and responsive user interaction.

functional_design_intentions.name: User comfort
functional_design_intentions.description: The two click buttons should provide a comfortable feel during user interaction.

functional_design_intentions.name: Responsive interaction
functional_design_intentions.description: The two click buttons should provide a responsive feel when used.

targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve existing non-targeted geometry and its relationships except where integration of the two requested click buttons necessarily requires change.

geometry.description: The final model contains two click-button features, each with a height of 2 millimetres.

functions.name: Comfortable user interaction
functions.description: The click buttons provide a comfortable user interaction.

functions.name: Responsive user interaction
functions.description: The click buttons provide a responsive user interaction.

behaviors.name: Click response
behaviors.description: The buttons exhibit a perceptible click response during user actuation, supporting the requested responsive feel.

validation_criteria.description: Exactly two click-button features exist in the final model.
Each click-button feature has a height of 2 millimetres.
The two click buttons support comfortable user interaction.
The two click buttons provide a responsive click feel during actuation.
Existing non-targeted model geometry and relationships remain unchanged except where button integration necessarily requires modification.

unresolved_requirements.description: The request does not identify the placement, spacing, alignment, orientation, or supporting geometry for the two click buttons.
candidate_interpretations: Place both buttons on an existing user-facing surface.
Place the buttons on separate suitable regions of the model.

unresolved_requirements.description: The button shape, footprint, and the reference from which the specified 2-millimetre height is measured are not stated.
candidate_interpretations: Measure height as the button projection above its supporting surface.
Measure height as the total button-feature extent.

unresolved_requirements.description: No measurable actuation travel, force, stiffness, feedback, or comfort criterion is supplied for the requested comfortable and responsive feel.
candidate_interpretations: Responsive feel refers to perceptible click feedback.
Responsive feel refers to prompt button displacement and return.
